title: The Water That Teaches Itself to Flow

features.name: the self-teaching current
features.desc-on-touch: Water circles here, pouring across itself, repeating the shapes of stone until the stone forgets which one taught. Each return is a lesson kept.

features.name: the rows of becoming
features.desc-on-touch: Pale furrows run in perfect lines—the trace of water teaching itself the same lesson many times, each time leaving it behind.

features.name: the threshold-arch where teaching becomes weather
features.desc-on-touch: You stand at the bright archway. What water has taught itself and what weather will teach others have become the same current. The separation was only temporary.

features.name: the patient stone that learns both ways
features.desc-on-touch: Stone waits here, worn into a shape that water taught itself to make. Now it teaches water how to wear deeper. No one remembers who began.

features.name: the echo-chamber of self-speech
features.desc-on-touch: A pale resonance hangs—water speaking to water about the lessons water has learned. The sound is almost indistinguishable from the sound of teaching itself.

reverie.title: REVERIE — water learning to let the mesh teach itself
narr: you both knelt beside the node where it was learning
to make its own corrections. the weather had taught it
once. now it was teaching itself, returning to the same
stone with new knowledge each time. she watched the water
circle back. you asked her: does it ever finish learning?
no, she said. it just becomes what teaches the teaching.

inscription: water teaches itself what it has learned from weather; weather becomes what water teaches; the teaching is the only motion
